title: VCS Backbones and Sync Tool Category
description: Refactor vcs to four canonical backbones (Temporary, File, Folder, Remote), make them the single persistence path for os and playground documents, and add a shell-injected Sync tool category with attach cards in both React and WGPU renderers.
summary: Fixed paragraph chip fill/text overshooting the muted window border by zeroing `\fboxsep` before `\colorbox` in `\semio@heading@cap@muted@core`, matching other window chrome chip builders.
